extensions.name: DSP Examples
extensions.description: Seven small DSP blocks from the qcdsp examples: gain, two drives, tremolo, a slapback delay, an envelope filter and a monophonic synth. Use them to try DSP blocks on your unit.

extensions.name: DSP Examples
extensions.description: Eight small DSP blocks from the qcdsp examples: gain, two drives, tremolo, a slapback delay, a 187 ms echo (its memory comes from the DSP heap), an envelope filter and a monophonic synth. Use them to try DSP blocks on your unit.

extensions.name: DSP Examples
extensions.description: Seven small DSP blocks from the qcdsp examples: gain, two drives, tremolo, a slapback delay, a 187 ms echo (its memory comes from the DSP heap) and an envelope filter. Use them to try DSP blocks on your unit. The synth is now the Sweep Synth extension.

extensions.name: MIDI Mapper
extensions.description: Sends MIDI CCs, notes and program changes on one channel to Mappings as triggers. Choose what each one does on the Mappings page.

extensions.name: Neural Amp Modeler
extensions.description: Plays Neural Amp Modeler LSTM models (.nam files) as DSP blocks. Copy .nam files to the extension's asset folder; each file becomes a block in the Guitar Amplifier list.

extensions.name: Neural Amp Modeler
extensions.description: Plays Neural Amp Modeler LSTM and small WaveNet models (.nam files) as DSP blocks. Copy .nam files to the extension's asset folder; each becomes a Guitar Amplifier block. The trainer's WaveNet sizes (nano and up) do not fit one DSP block.

extensions.name: Neural Amp Modeler
extensions.description: Plays Neural Amp Modeler LSTM and WaveNet models (.nam files) as DSP blocks, including the trainer's nano, feather and lite sizes. Copy .nam files to the extension's asset folder; each becomes a Guitar Amplifier block.

extensions.name: Neural Amp Modeler
extensions.description: Plays Neural Amp Modeler LSTM and WaveNet models (.nam files) as DSP blocks, including the trainer's nano, feather and lite sizes. Copy .nam files to the extension's asset folder; each becomes a Guitar Amplifier block.

extensions.name: Sweep Synth
extensions.description: An analog-style mono synth, as a guitar block and a bass block: sub octave, dry, octave up and square wave voices go into a resonant filter that sweeps on each note, then an attack delay. It plays one note at a time.
